interpretation: Preset regression only: these nine presets do not exercise the new clarinet or amp. Copy-synthesis reports measure the changed plugins separately. Local timings do not guarantee realtime performance on every host.

measurement: Clarinet (16 voices): mean 0.016 ms, p99 0.017 ms, 0.3% of 5.333 ms callback budget

clarinet_tuning.protocol: 1.2-second notes, steady-state after 350 ms; DC-subtracted Hann FFT; maximum within 0.8-1.2 times expected fundamental, log-parabolic bin interpolation

audition.method: whole-phrase or whole-note RMS matched to 0.1; no framewise normalization, limiter, or time warping
